pagedata.pyDeleteMemo: done query for tarikan data kpi progress
pagedata.pyBrowseSQL: select a.CLAIMID AS "POLICYDECLARATIONNO", a.claimno as "IDPEGA", TO_CHAR (a.NOPOLIS) AS "EDMNO", REPLACE (a.QQNAME, ',', ' ') AS "QQNAME", a.BUSINESSNAME AS "NOPOLIS", a.leader_member AS "BUSINESSTYPE", TO_CHAR (a.DATEOFLOSS, 'YYYY') AS "ENDDATE", TO_CHAR (a.DATEOFLOSS, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "EDMDATE", (select x.RECEIVEDDATE_1 from datapega.pc_asm_fw_gcnmfw_work x where x.pzinskey=A.CLAIMID) AS "PRODKE", TO_CHAR (a.FINISHREGISTERDATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "ACCUMCODE", TO_CHAR (a.CLOSECLAIMDATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "TABLEOBJECTNAME", TO_CHAR (a.REGISTERDATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "REGISTERID", TO_CHAR (a.transferpic_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "WARRANTYNO", (SELECT TO_CHAR (MIN (tanggal + 12 / 24), 'dd/mm/yyyy') FROM os_akseptasi_klaim WHERE caseid = a.claimid) AS "pyCountry", TO_CHAR (a.DATEOFREQUESTDOCUMENT, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "THEINSURED", TO_CHAR (a.SURVEYDATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "BUSINESSCODE", a.PICTEKNIK AS "OLDPOLICYNO", REPLACE (a.closeclaimnote, CHR (10), ' ') AS "GROUPPANEL", TO_CHAR (a.investigator_tf_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "SOBLEADER1", TO_CHAR (a.ANALYSTTORCLPUCL_DATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "SOBLEADER2", TO_CHAR (a.RCLPUCL_TF_TOANALYST, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "SOBLEADER0", a.RCLPUCL AS "SOBNAME", TO_CHAR (a.COMPLIANCE_CREATEDATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "SOURCEOFBUSINESS", TO_CHAR (a.CPLVALID_DATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "ISMAINFOLLOWING", TO_CHAR (a.POSTAUDIT_TF_ANALYSTDATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "STATUSBUSINESS", TO_CHAR (a.CPLPOSTAUDIT_VALIDDATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "EDMTYPE", a.ALASANKETERLAMBATAN AS "MARKETINGCODE", a.businesscode AS "BUSINESSNAME", (SELECT b.lsc_note FROM v_sts_claim b WHERE a.StatusClaim = b.LSC_ID) AS "CLIENTID", TO_CHAR (d.ACCEPTANCE_DATECOMITEE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "SYARIAHSTATUS", TO_CHAR (d.tglbayar, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "BRANCHCODE", d.status AS "BRANCHNAME", d.paymenttype AS "MARKETINGNAME", d.noakseptasi AS "STARTDATE", TO_CHAR (d.printlod_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "FLAGEDMBATAL", TO_CHAR (d.tglakseptasi, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "FOLLOWEDPOLICY", TO_CHAR (d.manual_acceptancedate, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "POOLINGSTATUS", TO_CHAR (d.MANUALACCEPTANCEDATECOMITEE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "AUTOCANCELPRINTSTATUS", TO_NUMBER (d.GROSSVALUE) AS "ASMAnalisator", a.SOBNAME AS "ISFOLLOWINGCHILD", A.CLAIMNO AS "pyNote", (select x.pxcreateoperator from datapega.pc_asm_fw_gcnmfw_work x where x.pzinskey=A.CLAIMID) AS "pyLabel", TO_CHAR (a.TGLDOKLENGKAP, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "pyGroup", TO_CHAR (d.ANALYST_TFKOMITEDATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "pyCountryName", TO_CHAR (a.trf_to_investigator, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "pzInsKey", TO_CHAR (d.receivedatelod, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "pyID", (select SUBSTR (X.REPORTDATE_1, 0, 8) from datapega.pc_asm_fw_gcnmfw_work x where x.pzinskey=A.CLAIMID) AS "IndexSpreading", TO_CHAR (d.TRANSFER_CASHIER_DATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "pyEmailAddress", (SELECT posisi FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_POSISI_PNC z WHERE z.caseid = a.CLAIMNO AND id = (SELECT MAX (id) FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_POSISI_PNC WHERE caseid = z.caseid)) AS "pyIssue", (SELECT TO_CHAR (startdate, 'dd/mm/yyyy') FROM t_general WHERE nopolis = a.nopolis AND prodke = a.prodke) AS "PlatNo", (SELECT TO_CHAR (enddate, 'dd/mm/yyyy') FROM t_general WHERE nopolis = a.nopolis AND prodke = a.prodke) AS "Position" FROM T_CLAIM_PNC a, t_claim_adjustment d WHERE TRUNC (D.TGLAKSEPTASI) >= TO_DATE ({TempDateReport.NoteKasir}, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND TRUNC (D.TGLAKSEPTASI) <= TO_DATE ({TempDateReport.AnaylstRemarks}, 'dd/mm/yyyy') and noakseptasi is not null and a.picteknik IN {ASIS:TempDateReport.UserTeknis} AND a.statuswork != 'Resolved-Rejected' and A.PICTEKNIK IN {ASIS:TempDateReport.UserTeknis} AND a.branchcode != '100639' AND a.grouppanel IN ('003', '004', '006', '009') AND a.businesscode NOT IN ('10145', '10168', '10165', '10164', '10053', '10075', '10126', '10011', '10077', '10007') AND d.claimid = a.ClaimID ORDER BY a.ClaimID ASC
